review_type: Independent mathematical and source-correspondence review; not a formal machine-checked proof.

checks.rationale: The lemma imports the established shared-HMAC column and adaptive row experiments. It changes the message-length parameter, while preserving the initial independence, private-key interfaces and complete shared-oracle accounting.

One uniform protected contribution is initially independent of h and auxiliary state. Its protected source family has the declared derivation interface; returned derived values and all available metadata may drive later requests.
Setting L_i=A_i+1 and lambda_i=ell(L_i) is valid within L_i<=2^61-65. Appending byte 01 is injective across variable-length infos, and SHA-256 offset padding retains the actual message length.

Classes and their finite N_i/L_i budgets use first-allocation order fixed before execution. Embedding the hidden row key when its class first appears incurs no target-class guessing factor; unallocated classes contribute identical hybrids.

q_S=B+2D+sum_i(2+ell(L_i))*N_i includes external salt-class computation and every real Expand row. The column primitive retains its own public pad-work cost, so external Gamma computation is conservatively counted as well.

At row i, the earlier classes are private tables, class i is the challenge row and every later real class is simulated with the common h. Hence q_i=B+2D+sum_{k>i}(2+ell(L_k))*N_k covers the full prefix, continuation and terminal test.

Distinct Gamma classes remain separate reduction slots. A locally sampled key that happens to equal the hidden challenge key is evaluated through the same h in the real branch, with that work charged to q_i; no collision-free conditioning is introduced.

The literal salt has 27 bytes. Adding five zero bytes produces a 32-byte representative with the identical 64-byte HMAC key block for every oracle, so this normalization is exact and costs no distinguishing term.

The ordered fields match purpose.rs, including suite 1, ContextBound profile 2, 36-byte policy state, 32-byte trust-root digest, purpose code, both length prefixes and BE16(32). The output is the first HKDF block F(F(r0,S),I||01).

Fixed-width fields and explicit label/context lengths uniquely parse the complete effective info. Runtime/owner identities remain lifecycle metadata; equal digest bytes are treated as equal effective fields, without assuming raw-root digest injectivity.

The info length is 107+|label|+|context|, with bounds 108..65898. Row messages are 109..65899 bytes, ell(65899)=1031 and a fresh maximum-size HMAC uses at most 1033 compression calls including its two pads.

The source fixture has label length 13 and context length 24, yielding five distinct 144-byte infos and 145-byte row messages. Matching peers alias those five entries while retaining separate owners; N=5 gives q_S=B+32 and q_1=B+2.

Every repeated full-info derivation has the same deterministic key value, while each accepted native derivation creates its own DerivedKey storage. A descriptor table plus an owner table preserves both facts; owner-indexed independent keys would be distinguishable.
DerivedKey::close clears only that object. SharedSecret::close removes future access through that source owner; existing derived owners keep their own key storage and runtime reference.

Runtime closure makes later open checks fail. Calls already past their relevant final admission/open check retain their native completion behavior, and previously exported copies remain with their recipients.
DerivedKey has no KeyLease; derivation takes the in-flight operation lease. The theorem fixes a separate lifetime bound N on distinct infos and retains the FFI live/pending-handle budget as metadata.

The inspected FFI derive path reserves under the runtime parent, computes, installs and then publishes. Publication checks parent liveness, and rollback drops unpublished owners, matching the retained registry metadata.

A private KDF evaluation allocates its descriptor even when publication subsequently fails. Retrying creates its actual new owner but retrieves the same entry; freshness is tested across all aliases before the first such computation.

With D=C=1, the displayed Delta_sdk follows from the length lemma. The induction preserves validation, admission, local liveness and publication; the comparison recomputes adaptive choices, exports and public responses in each game.

The event is equality of exported keys from distinct allocated infos, so it is an efficient available output-bit test. Independent lazy-table values give the adaptive union bound choose(N,2)*2^-256, followed by the Delta_sdk comparison cost.

A selected info is marked online before its first private KDF evaluation throughout the protected source family. All its aliases use one retained application-key interface with their native guards; other descriptor values may be exported.

The consequence invokes the existing one-key AEAD operational game, including its equal-length messages, nonce/associated-data choice and exact-challenge decryption rule. It does not require the SDK purpose key to be a durable root or chain seed.

Qualification uses available classical state and the source ledger, with zero score when there is no marked challenge. Fixing the application bit and then averaging yields 2*Delta_sdk, and fair guessing outside qualification gives 2*epsilon_AEAD.

The additional 2*Phi_256(d,Q_H) applies when the stopped execution actually realizes the stated common source family and available controller. Existing component, correctness and projection terms retain their prior definitions and placement.

The note retains the existing 97-byte pending-root source invariant and its two production call sites. The SDK purpose API supplies the concrete multiple-info instance; the new application consequence is attached to that declared key-use interface.
